items.name: ornament
items.title: Ornament
items.description: Decorative diamond band, dashed separator and dot-rule (aria-hidden): rules on whole pixel rows, diamonds drawn with Glyph (no rotate, no anti-aliasing). The semantic divider lives in the separator item.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project. Inspired by the YoRHa UI aesthetic; no original fonts, logos or assets are included. v4 migration: the duplicate `Separator` export is gone; import it from `@ui/separator`.
